signIn.title: Configure your workspace
signIn.lead: This is the admin app. Everyday work stays in {product} at its usual address.

card.signIn: Sign in with an ID card
card.hint: The ID card is read by the card software on this computer, and it will ask for your PIN. The other sign-in opens the provider's own page instead.
card.failed: That did not complete. Check the card is in the reader and try again.

missing.title: The card software is not running
missing.lead: Signing in with a card needs the ID-software and its browser extension on this computer. Install it, then try again — nothing here has to be redone.

loginFailed.cancelled: The sign-in was cancelled. Nothing happened — you can try again.
loginFailed.provider_error: The identity provider could not complete the sign-in. Try again; if it keeps failing, it is on their side rather than yours.
loginFailed.missing_code: The sign-in came back incomplete. Start it again from here.
loginFailed.expired: That sign-in took too long and has expired. Start a fresh one.
loginFailed.bad_state: That sign-in could not be matched to the one that started. Start a fresh one.
loginFailed.login_failed: The sign-in could not be completed. Try again.
loginFailed.unknown: The sign-in did not complete. Try again.

nothing.title: Nothing here for you to configure
nothing.lead: You are signed in, but no part of this workspace's configuration is yours. An administrator can give you access. Your everyday work is in {product}.

down.title: The admin service is not answering
down.lead: Nothing was changed. Try again in a minute. If it keeps happening, tell whoever runs this deployment: its start check may have stopped it, and its log says why.

page.lead: The configuration of this workspace, carried out as one file and back in.

export.title: Export
export.lead: Your whole configuration as one file — to keep, to hand to another workspace, or to edit and bring back.
export.failed: The configuration could not be downloaded: {reason}

import.title: Import
import.lead: Drop a configuration file. Nothing is written until you have seen exactly what it would do — and then either all of it lands, or none of it.
import.drop: Drop a file here, or click to choose one

rejected.type: That is not a configuration file — choose the .json file an export downloaded.
rejected.count: Drop one file at a time.

badge.lands: clean — lands only with the rest

note.failed: did not answer, so its part of the document could not be judged
note.skipped: No service in this workspace owns this section, so it is not applied here — the rest of the document can be.

stop.refused: {n} item was refused, so this document cannot be applied — none of it. Change it in the file (the reason says what) and drop the file again. | {n} items were refused, so this document cannot be applied — none of it. Change them in the file (each reason says what) and drop the file again.
stop.failed: A service did not answer, so this document could not be judged. Nothing was written. Preview again in a moment.
stop.bad: This file cannot be read as a configuration document. Nothing was written. Drop a file exported from this screen.
stop.other: The document could not be previewed: {reason}

act.downloadNow: Download the configuration as it is now

applied.head: Applied.
applied.rest: The whole document is in force.

moved.head: The configuration changed after your preview.
moved.rest: Nothing was written. Preview again to see what this document would do now — the new preview shows anyone else's change it would overwrite.

refused.head: Refused at Apply.
refused.rest: Something the configuration itself does not cover changed after your preview. Nothing was written — the refused item below says what.

failed.head: Nothing was written.
failed.rest: A service could not write its section, so the rest of the document was withheld.

rolledBack.head: Nothing of this document is in force.
rolledBack.rest: A service could not write its section after another had written its own, so that one was restored to what it held before.

partial.head: Only part of this document is in force.
partial.rest: A service could not write its section, and restoring the section written before it failed too. Preview again: the new preview shows exactly what is still to land, and applying it completes the document.

other.head: The document could not be applied.

line.applied: {n} change landed, recorded in the history under your name | {n} changes landed, recorded in the history under your name
line.appliedNothing: nothing in it changes this section
line.withheld: clean, not applied because another section did not land
line.refused: nothing of this section was written
line.rolledBack: written, then restored to what it held before this import
line.notRestored: holds this document's section — the restore after the failure did not succeed
line.skipped: not applied here — no service in this workspace owns it
